simple.meaning: חָקָה (châqâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to carve ; by implication, to delineate ; also to entrench.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across 1 Kings, Job, Ezekiel, beginning at 1 Kings 6:35. Its contexts include Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָקָה (H2707).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חָקָה (châqâh) / H2707 is traced through 1 Kings 6:35, Job 13:27, Ezekiel 8:10, Ezekiel 23:14 as a generated source-based concept entry.
